headline: Exelon (EXC) Q2 Earnings Match Estimates
summary: Exelon (EXC) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of 0.00% and +5.47%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
